reviews.text:
From our very first meeting with Austin through the design phase and all the way to the completion of our stunning new pool, working with G3 was an outstanding experience from start to finish. Having built three pools over the years, I can confidently say that G3 is by far the best pool company I’ve ever worked with.

Their attention to detail was exceptional, and the level of communication throughout the entire process was truly top-notch. Every question we had was answered promptly, and any issues that arose were handled quickly and professionally. The team’s commitment to quality and customer satisfaction was evident at every stage.

If you’re considering building a pool and want an experience that combines excellence, transparency, and craftsmanship, I highly recommend reaching out to G3 for a consultation. You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: John Hodges

reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with our new pool/patio project and highly recommend G3 Pools to anyone looking for excellent craftsmanship and top-notch service. What really stood out was their customer service — Tom and team genuinely care about their clients and go above and beyond to make sure you’re happy with the results. Whether it was answering our many questions, helping us choose the right design, or following up after completion, they were always friendly and helpful.

Thank you for transforming our backyard into a beautiful oasis!
reviews.author: Tara Gibson

reviews.text:
G3 pools did a fantastic job constructing our family pool. They started the job immediately - as soon as we signed the contract, they had a crew out here digging! Anytime we had any issues during the process, like rainwater needing to be removed, they sent someone out to address and fix whatever the problem was. They involved us in all of the design and details, accompanying us to the tile store to help make careful selections on what to pick for our ledge stone, decking and water line tile. Any questions were answered and followed up immediately. Excellent communication and friendly service from everyone. Matt was specifically our project manager and he was on top of it!

As for the finished product, our pool is gorgeous! A backyard oasis and my new favorite place to unwind and spend time with the family. My husband and I recently decided to forgo a date night out,  ordering food to enjoy poolside instead. It was a romantic getaway at home! The kids love it too. In fact, we recently used the pool for a birthday party. Fun for the entire family, in style.
reviews.author: Stacy Seeley

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Tom from G3 Pools, and I can't recommend him highly enough! From our first meeting, it was clear that Tom is not only knowledgeable but also genuinely passionate about his work. He took the time to understand my vision for my backyard and provided insightful suggestions that transformed my ideas into reality.

Tom's attention to detail is remarkable. He guided me through the entire pool installation process, ensuring that every aspect was executed flawlessly. His team was professional and efficient, and they maintained a clean worksite, which I greatly appreciated.

What truly sets Tom apart is his commitment to customer satisfaction. He was always available to answer my questions and address any concerns, making the entire experience stress-free. The end result is a stunning pool that has become the centerpiece of my outdoor space.

If you're considering a pool project, I wholeheartedly recommend Tom and G3 Pools. His expertise, dedication, and exceptional service make him the best in the business!

Before and after pictures
reviews.author: Reco Chazarreta

reviews.text: I recently had my backyard renovated by G3 Pools, and I couldn’t be happier with the end result. From start to finish, their team was professional, attentive, and communicative. There were some bumps and bruises along the way but they always took care of everything. I loved their vision for my yard and seeing it come to life was really fun! I highly recommend G3 Pools for any outdoor project!!
reviews.author: A Yearous

reviews.text:
G3 Pools transformed our backyard into an area of relaxation, recreation and health that turned out to be an exceptional choice.  The experience my wife and I had with G3 Pools, specifically Matt (designer) and Blake has been very pleasant.

Design and Customization - One of the things that stood out was G3 Pools commitment to design and customization. From the initial consultation to the final installation, Matt worked closely with us to create a pool that perfectly suited our vision and space. Matt took into consideration every aspect of our preferences, from pool shape and size to the choice of materials and water features. The result was outstanding and exceeded our expectations.

Customer Service and Professionalism - From the very beginning, Matt impressed us with his professionalism and dedication to customer satisfaction.  He communicated every step of the way, providing updates and addressing any questions or concerns promptly. Matt’s commitment to delivering on promises and deadlines was evident throughout the project, which made the entire process less stressful.

Value for Money - While the quality and craftsmanship provided by G3 Pools are unquestionably top-tier, we found their pricing to be competitive and reasonable compared to other pool companies we considered. The value received for the investment sets them apart from their competitors in our opinion.

We couldn't be more pleased with the decision to select G3 Pools for our backyard transformation. The professionalism, design, commitment and quality, to customer satisfaction is what stood out to us. If someone is in the market for a pool that is beautiful, functional and built to last, we totally recommend G3 Pools. They have turned our backyard vision into a reality, and we are grateful for their excellent work.
reviews.author: NikosReviews

reviews.text: From the very start it was clear that G3 Pools was serious about our project. They scheduled outside of normal business hours to come to our house just to discuss what we were potentially thinking about getting done. I met with Spencer and Dakota and asked what seemed like a billion questions. They were very knowledgeable and made all kinds of measurements to make sure that what they would be quoting would be possible and practical. Everyone involved in the process answered all of my questions and I learned quite a bit. They gave me suggestions to look into Pool financing and I was surprised at how easy everything was. Excavation was unbelievably quick and from start to swimmable status was only 58 calendar days. Going with Spencer to select our tile and coping was a fun experience and it was exciting to get to see and feel the products that we were considering. We ended up exploring an upgrade path we hadn't originally intended and Tom was immensely helpful in making it a reality. The gunite shell was done in one day and after that cured we really started flying through the steps. Something that really stood out to me was Tom's attention to how pleased we were with the progress and we didn't move forward until we gave a green light. We are always trying to find times to get in the pool when the weather allows it or get in the spa when it's too cold. Everything is controllable with an app, you can set up a schedule, change pump speeds, light colors, turn on the heater, etc. We really can't believe that a few months ago we were considering looking into a pool and now we are proud owners of a modern and unique custom pool. G3 made something complicated very easy and understandable and will always be our go-to suggestion for a pool builder.
reviews.author: Nolana Bradford

reviews.text: G3 pools checks all the boxes!!! They are timely, professional and produce a great product.  We will be celebrating our 1 year pool anniversary in July.  Tom earned our business in an honest way and we are glad we went with him to build our first pool.
reviews.author: Todd Hopkins

data.summary: The Google reviews appear authentic in content but are suspiciously uniform (all 5-star in sample, no criticism). The stark contrast with Yelp's 'zero stars' mention and the BBB B- rating suggests a polarized customer experience or potential review management on Google. The positive reviews are detailed, but the complete absence of negative feedback in the sample is a red flag.
fake_signals: All sampled Google reviews are 5-star, no negative or mixed reviews in sample
Google review sample shows high similarity in positive tone and structure
Limited total review volume (63) for a pool company across primary platform

positive_evidence: Reviews mention follow-up and fixing issues during construction (e.g., rainwater)

authentic_signals: Google reviews contain specific details (crew names like Austin, Tom, Matt, Blake; project phases)
Some variation in writing style and specific mentions (e.g., rainwater removal, tile store visit)
complaint_patterns: Potential quality/value concerns (implied by Yelp 'you get what you pay for')
